newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse shut for elections.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse shut for elections.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange was shut on Monday because of national and provincial elections. It will reopen on Tuesday.
On Sunday, the Karachi 100-share index soared 63.05 points, or 4.11 percent, to close at 1,597.26 in a turnover of 39.73 million shares. Gainers beat losers 188 to 30.

Dealers said speculative buying was fuelled by hopes that the Pakistan Muslim League led by Nawaz Sharif will win the polls, forced by President Farooq Leghari's November 5 dismissal of Benazir Bhutto's government on disputed corruption charges.
